purpose: The one code base a new GilbPlatform app starts from: it loads the app's style, signs a person in and out, opens their own vault for the app (making it at the first sign-in), draws the frame for a wide window and a phone, and lets them share that vault.
namedChanges: 0.1.1. the centre and the right region scroll themselves, take the focus with Tab, are named and show a focus ring, so a keyboard scrolls a screen taller than the window (run in Chrome only; other browsers were not run); words.detail is new; contrast.test.ts counts a placeholder's own opacity (src/Workspace.tsx, src/starterApp.css, src/words.ts, src/StarterApp.test.tsx, src/contrast.test.ts)

New code, written on 2026-11-21. No product code was copied: every part is a call into app-shell, signin, lws-session-bridge, style-runtime, vault-share-sheet or vault-switcher. scripts/check-host-agnostic.mjs and src/hostAgnostic.test.ts are the repo's frame, copied from vault-share-sheet.

library.title: Starter app (a new app's first version: app shell with sign-in, own vault, share)
library.note: Take it whole to start a new GilbPlatform app: git clone https://github.com/KaiGilb/GilbPlatformCode.git, then node GilbPlatformCode/apps/starter-app/scripts/take.mjs <new-app-folder> --id <id> --name "<Name>" --port <your own dev port>, then npm install, npm test, npm run dev:fake. It gives the style loaded at start, sign in and sign out, the person's own vault for the app made at the first sign-in, the frame for a wide window and a phone, the vault chooser and the share sheet. It gives no records: add your record screens in src/records/ and src/sections.tsx, with lws-records, record-sync and record-autosave (fields save as the person types, with no Save, Cancel or Edit). vaultType in src/settings.ts ships empty and stays empty until Agent.Concept gives the type; until then run only npm run dev:fake (fake mode). Not for an app you already have (install the unit: node scripts/peers.mjs starter-app) and not for one part alone: the frame alone is app-shell, sign-in alone is signin, sharing alone is vault-share-sheet. Not yet proven live: tested on the fake platform only, in Chrome only (2026-11-21); nothing of it has run against production. Also found as: starter; starter app; new app; create a new app; first version; app skeleton; boilerplate; scaffold; app shell with sign-in.
